checked.claim: A token-less participant's side pick is offered once per mode opening and kept across a Logic Dive's questions, with no control to change it.
checked.why: offerSidePick returns when pickOpenFor equals `${mode}|${openedAt}` or when zone.picks holds the actor. openedAt and picks are set only in zoneStart; phase() spreads the old zone and patches only what diveQuestion names (question, answers, counts, set), so both survive every question. sidesNow reads the kept pick for an actor with no hall token. The machine would take a different pick (only the same side is refused), but sideOnPrimary is reached only through requestTrialSide, whose one caller is offerSidePick (grep of scripts/ outside tests: bridge-asks.mjs:366 definition, gm-bridge.mjs:54 re-export, trial-zones-ui.mjs:456 the call). No GM-side road found: game.drpg has zoneSides (a read) and no side writer (api.mjs:1126). No test in scripts/tests*.mjs or audit/harness presses .drpg-side-pick or pins picks across questions (grep: 0 hits). The handbook (player-handbook.en.md:932) says only 'With no token in the hall you get a window to pick a side', which neither allows nor forbids once a set.

checked.claim: The set editor's Save (and the picker's Start) is judged only after the window has closed: a refused set is a toast and what was typed is lost.
checked.why: The primary's callback is readSetForm alone (:216); DialogV2.wait resolves on that answer (ui-kit.mjs:1344 `return DialogV2.wait(config)`, the kit adds no hold), and setRefusal runs in saveDiveSet after the wait (:222, :140-144), warns and answers null. editDiveSet hands back null; openDiveSets' list handler only redraws the list; the 'new' road (:361) ends there too. No `required`, no disabled Save, no reopen with the typed values. The picker's Start is the same shape (:310-324 then startZone's warnings, trial-zones.mjs:261-272). The core claim stands; the parenthetical 'Enter in any field presses Save' rests on DialogV2 parsing the content into its own form, which utils.mjs dialogContent (:1030-1034, a detached div holding the body's own <form>) does not settle and the reader itself puts under not_established - that part is not established here either. The verdict word 'stale-state' fits poorly (nothing redraws late; the window refuses after it closed); the substance and the severity stand.
checked.evidence: scripts/trial-zones-ui.mjs:216 `primary: { action: "save", ..., callback: (e, b, d) => readSetForm(d.element) }`; :221-222 `if (!asked || asked === "cancel") return null; return saveDiveSet(id, asked);`; :140-143 `const refused = setRefusal(set); if (refused) { ui.notifications.warn(refused); return null;`

checked.claim: The zone picker's set list is drawn once; a set made, changed or deleted through its own 'Logic Dive sets...' button does not reach the open picker.
checked.why: openZonePicker passes no `live` (ui-kit.mjs:1340 `if (live) keepLive(dialog, live)` starts it only for one); its render's paint only toggles hidden and the hint, and reads the select that was drawn. diveSetStore is registered with no onChange (settings.mjs:2711-2712 'No onChange: the set editor and the console read it at each redraw') and no hook, keepLive source or rerender of .drpg-zone-picker was found in scripts/ (grep of drpg-zone-picker and diveSetStore outside tests: only reads and the store's own writes). The picker is not modal (drpgWindow's modal defaults false), so the sets window opens beside it and the picker stays as drawn. A deleted set still chosen reaches startZone, whose zoneArgsRefusal answers null when diveEventOf finds nothing (trial-zones.mjs:250-251), so the primary's refusal comes back as DRPG.Zones.notStarted - as the finding says.
